I will farm this maize plot much like I did last season, but I will put a bit more money into seed and fertilizer because the rains here usually come once and I do not want to waste the season. I have seen other farmers near me do better with improved seed and one bag each of DAP and urea spread on about this size of land, so I will do that if I get the cash in time. Because this land is mine, I will also carry some manure to it, but I will not irrigate and I will not spend money on pesticide unless there is a serious problem.
